summary: legal checked in 6 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Recommendation: retain SearchWoot's private gate. Woot API access is documented, but rights for storage, derivatives, public display, alerts, or monetization are unconfirmed; all four legal checklist tasks remain open. Continue read-only evidence capture and keep external outreach unsent pending owner and human-counsel authorization.

Recommendation: retain the private launch gate. Continue read-only evidence capture and keep external outreach unsent pending owner and human-counsel authorization. Rights, retention, consent, vendor, incident, security, accuracy, attribution, and measurement gates remain incomplete.

Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep the gated product private. Official API access is documented, but rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize returned data are not established; current public terms point against those uses. Security, accuracy/freshness, privacy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible growth remains conditional when existing consent, cookie/analytics disclosure, terms, affiliate disclosure, claims, provenance, rights, and platform-policy boundaries are preserved. Incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker. Compliance is technical baseline evidence only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown; open findings include banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms gaps. Revenue evidence covers one day: $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed commission. No launch or ROI claim is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed. Partial progress is evidenced by official source documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms. No task is closable because authoritative rights, field-level provenance, operator-confirmed retention and user workflows, deployed consent and GA4 settings, log/vendor inventory, incident/request procedures, and human-counsel review remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, alert and operational data flows, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep external permission outreach unsent pending owner and human-counsel authorization.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price-use limits, and affiliate or advertising permission. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel and owner review. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident handling, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Fleet review disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible growth; evidence_needed for fleet-wide compliance and security clearance. Do not close compliance, data-quality, analytics, revenue, site, or launch-readiness gates without site-specific evidence. Analytics is broadly available but has permission/configuration gaps; data quality is green for registry and operational checkouts, yellow for analytics freshness and revenue attribution; the aggregate revenue row cannot be assigned to a site. Continue existing source-dated measurement only, preserve unknowns, and do not request duplicate telemetry or infer legal clearance from technical passes.
